output.lesson:
📚 You could fit 1 million Earths inside the Sun!

The Sun is HUGE. If the Sun were a basketball, Earth would be a tiny sesame seed floating next to it. That's how small our planet is compared to the Sun!

The Sun is so big that it makes up 99.8% of all the mass in our entire solar system. All the planets, moons, asteroids, and comets together make up just 0.2%!

Did you know? The Sun is actually a star — just like the twinkling stars you see at night. It's the closest star to Earth, which is why it looks so big and bright!

Ask your parents: What else could you fit a million of inside the Sun?
